description: Signed refusals: every registered reason, tampering, and non-conforming reasons.

signature_profile.note: -00 section 4.2 item 4 leaves the signature format to the deployment. These vectors use one profile, the one the existing cross-implementation refusal vector already uses: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) over the RFC 8785 serialization of the JSON object with exactly the members issued_at, reason and request_digest; key_id is the raw 32-byte public key and sig the 64-byte signature, both lowercase hex.
signature_profile.key_id: raw Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex

cases.description: A signed refusal of request pos-subject-record (JSON binding) with reason not_authorized.
cases.ambiguity: §4.2 / §10: -00 names the refusal's contents but no member names or signature format. Vectors use request_digest, reason, issued_at, key_id and sig with the signature profile in refusal.json. In the CBOR binding the same map is the frame; the signature is still over the RFC 8785 body.
